mapper.sql: id,platform_order_id,shop_no, shop_name,paid_time,express_time, status,sales_record_number,order_fee, order_weight,platform_name,country_name_en, country_name_cn,buyer_user_id,buyer_name, employee_id,employee_name,remark, return_create_time,refund_time,currency_code, currency_rate
mapper.select:
select droi.return_order_id, droi.platform_order_id, droi.platform_name, droi.shop_name, droid.sku_no, droid.quantity as returnNum, droi.order_fee, round(droi.order_fee * droi.currency_rate,2) as cnyRealTimeAmount, round(droi.order_fee * droi.cny_settle_rate,2) as cny_settle_amount, droi.status, droi.return_create_time, droi.order_time from dmp_return_order_info droi inner join dmp_return_order_item droid on droi.id = droid.return_order_id
and droi.return_order_id like concat('%',#{params.returnOrderId},'%')
and droi.platform_order_id like concat('%',#{params.platformOrderId},'%')
and droi.shop_name like concat('%',#{params.shopName},'%')
and droi.platform_name like concat('%',#{params.platformName},'%')
and droi.status = #{params.status}
and droi.return_create_time >= #{params.returnCreateTime_begin}::timestamp
and droi.return_create_time <= #{params.returnCreateTime_end}::timestamp
and droi.order_time >= #{params.orderTime_begin}::timestamp
and droi.order_time <= #{params.orderTime_end}::timestamp
${params.param}
